model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values across a range of iterations for different models. The x-axis represents the number of iterations on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 140,000 with tick labels at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis represents loss on a linear scale, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are six lines in the plot: the purple line for Vanilla starts at approximately 3.35 and decreases to around 2.55; the blue line for StrmLLM (n=64) starts at about 3.35 and decreases to around 2.55; the orange line for SepLLM (n=64) starts at approximately 3.35 and decreases to around 2.55; the green line for SepLLM (n=64, H) starts at around 3.35 and decreases to approximately 2.55; the red line for SepLLM (n=64, H/T) starts at about 3.35 and decreases to around 2.55; and the dark blue line for SepLLM (n=128) starts at approximately 3.35 and decreases to around 2.5. All lines exhibit a sharp decline from 0 to 20,000 iterations, then gradually decrease with minimal change after 80,000 iterations.
